# netbox_table_config (Resource)

A table configuration chooses the columns and the order of the rows of a table in the NetBox web interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_table_config" "example" {
  name        = "Sites with region"
  object_type = "dcim.site"
  table       = "SiteTable"
  columns     = ["name", "status", "region", "tenant"]
  ordering    = ["name"]
  shared      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `columns` (List of String) The columns of the table, in the order they are shown.
- `name` (String) The name of the table configuration.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the table, for example `dcim.site`.
- `table` (String) The name of the table, for example `SiteTable`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the table configuration.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the table configuration is in use. NetBox turns it on by default.
- `ordering` (List of String) The columns the rows are sorted by. A leading minus sign sorts in descending order.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether other users can use the table configuration. NetBox turns it on by default.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user who owns the table configuration.
- `weight` (Number) The weight of the table configuration. Heavier ones are used last.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_table_config.example 1
```
